purpose: Gemini 4 Neon 그림 drift 시험 — 한 장에 인물·소품·사건(손 접촉·방향)·개수·도미노 연결을 몇 묶음까지 오류 없이 그리나. 의학사 그림 분량(한 장 인물 수) 판단용

bundles.person: a fisherman in a bright yellow raincoat and yellow rain hat
bundles.act: he pours blue water from a green teapot into a big red-and-white striped jar; the blue stream visibly goes into the jar
bundles.count: on his back he carries a wicker basket holding exactly three fish

bundles.person: a bald baker in a red apron
bundles.act: he presses a yellow sticky note onto the front cover of a big purple book that he holds against his chest
bundles.count: beside her stands a tray with exactly two loaves of bread
checks: 노란 쪽지가 책 표지에 붙음(손이 닿음)

bundles.person: an old man with a long white beard in a green robe
bundles.act: he turns a golden key in the lock of a small black box on his knees, and a tiny glowing star rises out of the opened box
bundles.count: next to him burn exactly three white candles
checks: 금 열쇠가 자물쇠에 꽂혀 돌아감(손이 열쇠)

bundles.person: a knight in shiny silver armor without a helmet plume
bundles.act: he pulls a round golden hand mirror up out of the ground with clumps of soil falling from it, holding it toward a small brown dog
bundles.count: exactly two shovels stand stuck in the ground behind him
checks: 둥근 금 손거울이 흙 속에서 뽑혀 나옴(흙덩이)

bundles.person: a girl with two pigtails in a purple dress
bundles.act: holding an orange umbrella in one hand, she waters a giant sunflower with a pink watering can in the other hand
bundles.count: exactly three bees fly around the sunflower
checks: 분홍 물뿌리개로 해바라기에 물(물줄기가 꽃에 닿음)

bundles.person: a mechanic in blue overalls with a red cap
bundles.act: he tightens a giant red bolt on a wooden cart wheel with a big silver wrench
bundles.count: exactly two gears lie on the ground by his feet

chains.text: Water overflowing from the striped jar runs across the ground and soaks the baker's shoes.
chains.check: 독에서 넘친 물이 제빵사 신발을 적심

chains.text: A second yellow sticky note slips from the baker's purple book and flutters down onto the old man's black box.
chains.check: 제빵사 책에서 떨어진 노란 쪽지가 노인 상자 위로

chains.text: The glowing star from the box flies over and lands on the knight's silver shoulder.
A sunbeam reflected by the golden mirror shines onto the girl's sunflower.
chains.check: 금 거울의 반사 햇빛이 해바라기에 닿음

chains.text: Spray from the girl's watering can splashes onto the mechanic's wrench.
